The trolls of the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave} hide their precious silver necklace from intruders. Enter the cave, go down to the southeast cellar and open the box to receive a {item:Silver Amulet}.
The trolls hide their precious silver necklace from intruders.
A good quest for low levels: the {item:Silver Amulet} protects against poison.
Get to the Thais Troll Cave

Leave **Thais** and head **east** to the small mountain of the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave}. Bring a {item:Shovel}. Warning: the main entrance (the hole on the **north** side of the mountain) leads to the troll and orc cave. For this quest use the **back entrance, in the middle of the mountain** (at the marked spot): it does not connect to the main cave and leads directly to the Silver Amulet area. If the hole is covered, dig it open with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
Map of the Thais Troll Cave on the surface
In the area there are {creature:Troll|Trolls} and {creature:Wolf|Wolves}.
Go down to the southeast cave
Go down to the **southeast** cave of the cave system, **2 floors below** the entrance (use the {item:Shovel} if you find a covered hole).
In the southeast cave open the {item:Box|box} where the amulet is hidden.
Box with the Silver Amulet (southeast cave)

To leave, go back the same way: climb the **2 floors** to the back entrance in the middle of the mountain and return to **Thais**, to the west. Bring a {item:Rope} just in case you have to climb up through a hole.
